def _f(x):
    if not isinstance(x, str):
        x = str(x)
    if x == "":
        return ""
    # split on whitespace runs
    tokens = x.split()
    if not tokens:
        return ""
    # suppress extra char if original ends with whitespace
    suppress = x[-1].isspace()
    rev = [t[::-1] for t in tokens]
    if not suppress:
        last_orig = tokens[-1]
        last_char = last_orig[-1]
        rev[-1] = last_char + rev[-1]
    return " ".join(rev)
notes: The box splits the input into whitespace-separated words, reverses each word, and then—unless the original string ends in whitespace—prepends the last character of the final word to that reversed final word, rejoining everything with single spaces.
